description.en: Same as CreateEvHiMdlForNPCID, but always creates the model without a base (_no_base is fixed to false and _mem fixed to DEV_MEM_NAME_EVENT) — intended for animal-type NPC dialogue models looked up by NPC ID.
Name to assign the created model.
NPC ID string identifying the character to create.
Optional; whether to create it in "Talk" mode for dialogue (defaults to true).
Handle of the newly created character model.

example.code:
// Create a high-detail dialogue model for an animal-type NPC
local hAnimalH = CreateEvHiMdlForNPCID_Animal("animalH", "evc0020");
